name: Other Amounts 16
definition: Identifies other amounts pertaining to the transaction.

ChargesFees.name: Charges Fees
ChargesFees.definition: Amount of money paid for the provision of financial services that cannot be categorised by another qualifier.

CountryNationalFederalTax.name: Country National Federal Tax
CountryNationalFederalTax.definition: Amount of country, national or federal tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the account servicer is located.

ExecutingBrokerAmount.name: Executing Broker Amount
ExecutingBrokerAmount.definition: Amount of money paid to an executing broker as a commission.

IssueDiscountAllowance.name: Issue Discount Allowance
IssueDiscountAllowance.definition: Amount of money defined as a discount on a new issue or on a tranche of an existing issue.

LocalTax.name: Local Tax
LocalTax.definition: Tax charged by the jurisdiction in which the financial instrument settles.

LocalBrokerCommission.name: Local Broker Commission
LocalBrokerCommission.definition: Amount of commission paid to a local broker.

Margin.name: Margin
Margin.definition: Amount of money deposited by the trading party in a margin account.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: An amount that is not indicated by a known business denomination.

RegulatoryAmount.name: Regulatory Amount
RegulatoryAmount.definition: Amount of money charged by a regulatory authority, for example, Securities and Exchange fees.

SpecialConcession.name: Special Concession
SpecialConcession.definition: Amount of drawdown or other reduction from or in addition to the deal price.

TransferTax.name: Transfer Tax
TransferTax.definition: Amount of tax levied on a transfer of ownership of financial instrument.

WithholdingTax.name: Withholding Tax
WithholdingTax.definition: Amount of money that will be withheld by a tax authority.

NetGainLoss.name: Net Gain Loss
NetGainLoss.definition: Amount representing the difference between the cost and the current price of a security. In the context of securities settlement, it is the amount paid or received when the instructions are netted or paired off.

ConsumptionTax.name: Consumption Tax
ConsumptionTax.definition: A tax on spending on goods and services.

MatchingConfirmationFee.name: Matching Confirmation Fee
MatchingConfirmationFee.definition: Amount of money charged for matching and/or confirmation.

ConvertedAmount.name: Converted Amount
ConvertedAmount.definition: Amount following a foreign exchange conversion.

OriginalCurrencyAmount.name: Original Currency Amount
OriginalCurrencyAmount.definition: Posting/settlement amount in its original currency when conversion from/into another currency has occurred.

BookValue.name: Book Value
BookValue.definition: Cost of the securities. May be requested in some countries for tax purposes.

AccruedCapitalisationAmount.name: Accrued Capitalisation Amount
AccruedCapitalisationAmount.definition: Amount of unpaid interest (on bonds which have defaulted and have subsequently |restructured), which is capitalized and added to the original principal amount of the bond.

LocalTaxCountrySpecific1.name: Local Tax Country Specific 1
LocalTaxCountrySpecific1.definition: Local tax as defined by the country in its market practice document.

LocalTaxCountrySpecific2.name: Local Tax Country Specific 2
LocalTaxCountrySpecific2.definition: Local tax as defined by the country in its market practice document.

LocalTaxCountrySpecific3.name: Local Tax Country Specific 3
LocalTaxCountrySpecific3.definition: Local tax as defined by the country in its market practice document.

LocalTaxCountrySpecific4.name: Local Tax Country Specific 4
LocalTaxCountrySpecific4.definition: Local tax as defined by the country in its market practice document.

SharedBrokerageAmount.name: Shared Brokerage Amount
SharedBrokerageAmount.definition: Amount paid as result of transactions subject to shared brokerage commissions.

MarketMemberFeeAmount.name: Market Member Fee Amount
MarketMemberFeeAmount.definition: Indicates the total fees related to the trade, with deduction of rebates (on brokerage, commission or differential) granted by the market member (fee amount with tax excluded).

RemunerationAmountRequest.name: Remuneration Amount Request
RemunerationAmountRequest.definition: Specifies that this information is available upon request.

RemunerationAmount.name: Remuneration Amount
RemunerationAmount.definition: Specifies the source and amount of any other remuneration received or to be received by the broker in connection with the transaction.

BorrowingInterestAmount.name: Borrowing Interest Amount
BorrowingInterestAmount.definition: Amount to be paid by the lender to the borrower calculated based on the interest rate.

BorrowingFee.name: Borrowing Fee
BorrowingFee.definition: Amount to be paid by the Borrower to the Lender for the securities borrowed calculated based on the bond loan rate.

NetMarketValue.name: Net Market Value
NetMarketValue.definition: Net market value of the securities lent used to calculate the collateral amount.

RemainingFaceValue.name: Remaining Face Value
RemainingFaceValue.definition: Remaining nominal value of a security.

RemainingBookValue.name: Remaining Book Value
RemainingBookValue.definition: Remaining value at which an asset is carried on a balance sheet.

ClearingBrokerCommission.name: Clearing Broker Commission
ClearingBrokerCommission.definition: Amount of commission paid to a clearing broker.

DifferenceInPrice.name: Difference In Price
DifferenceInPrice.definition: Difference between the deal price and another reference price.

OddLotFee.name: Odd Lot Fee
OddLotFee.definition: Specifies that the odd-lot differential or equivalent fee has been paid by such customer in connection with the execution of an order for an odd-lot number of shares or units (or principal amount) of a security and the fact that the amount of any such differential or fee will be furnished upon oral or written request.
